# Fig 6. Convergent evidence

This figure integrates the two independent lines of evidence: community assembly processes (βNTI / RCbray) and microbial co-occurrence networks.

## Load results


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse); library(patchwork)
todos   <- read_csv("06.null-models-results/qpen_pairwise_all.csv")
resumen <- read_csv("06.null-models-results/qpen_process_summary.csv")
```
:::


## Panel A — βNTI by group


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pA <- ggplot(todos, aes(grupo, bNTI, fill = grupo)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2,2), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.25, size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(beta*"NTI"), tag = "A") +
  theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "none",
                          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```
:::


## Panel B — Assembly process composition


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
process_colors <- c("Heterogeneous.Selection" = "#1B7A4E",
                    "Homogeneous.Selection"   = "#A7fcc1",
                    "Dispersal.Limitation"    = "#329D9C",
                    "Homogenizing.Dispersal"  = "#7Fd3d2",
                    "Undominated"             = "gray70")
pB <- ggplot(resumen, aes(grupo, porcentaje, fill = process)) +
  geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values = process_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of comparisons", fill = "Process", tag = "B") +
  theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
```
:::
